json.description: Runtime config for form-submission routing and metadata. Applies to every <form data-aed-form> on the page — overrides its action attribute and injects hidden _subject / brand fields. Pair with the `forms` addon (which handles the actual AJAX submit).

endpoint.description: POST target. Usually the emailit contact-proxy Cloudflare Worker URL. If set, overrides each form's `action` attribute at page load. Leave empty to respect per-form actions from contact.json.

subject.description: Subject line override. If non-empty, sets/replaces the hidden `_subject` field on every form. Empty = per-form _subject stays.

brandOverride.description: Force a specific value in the submitted `brand` field. Default brand comes from PUBLIC_BRAND at build time; set this for staging or to test fallback routing (e.g. 'unverified-test' → fallback brand).

debug.description: Log the full form payload to the console on submit. Useful for troubleshooting; leave off in production.
